newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen Int'l says in acquisition talks.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen Int'l says in acquisition talks.

text.p: Opitcal products distributor Shenzhen International Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it was in talks regarding a possible acquisition but that no terms had yet been finalised.

The company said in a statement that "confidential preliminary discussions have been commenced relating to a possible acquisition by the company which is a notifiable transaction" under the Hong Kong listing rules.
"It should be noted that the terms of the agreement have not been finalised yet and thus no assurance can be given that it will proceed," it added.
Shenzhen International shares rose HK$0.024 or 12.97 percent in the last two trading days to HK$0.209 on Tuesday.
